page.layout: One page of text, centred. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Below the text, a centred date and place line, then the signature name. Faint show-through from the reverse side lies below.

main_text.l: adiungant ; nisi prius probè fidem exploraue-
rint. Hæc in mentem mihi nunquam venire
potuissent, nunquam etiam venissent, nisi à
primariis Iesuiticæ colluuiei sociis hæc singula
& multo alia plura accepissem, quæ in patriæ
& Ecclesiæ salutem in apricum producere de-
bui, nunc quidem solum delineando, at suo

page.notes: The faint letters and numbers below the signature (apparently "P. OTTONO" and a short line with "1608" and "LECTO") are show-through from the reverse side and are not transcribed. The bottom-left corner shows stains only. The signature name is set in small capitals and is transcribed in capitals as printed.
